source.title: Biblia Sacra Vulgata, Clementine edition (1592)
source.attribution: Biblia Sacra Vulgata, editio Clementina (1592), public domain. USFX text from seven1m/open-bibles, held by the Vetus V0 app.
source.provenance: Taken verse by verse from vetus-v0/data/vulgate/lat-clementine.usfx.xml (SHA-256 5da5f3c07fa6896d4a2b45f5f309c3ece43e554fd059b31b8ae3688bbd182baf) by scripts/corpus-la-build.mts; nothing was retyped. Clementine spelling kept (ae ligatures as printed, i/j and u/v as printed, no macrons). One verse is one sentence (the verse is not split, although it may hold several clauses or sentences), so every sentence is addressable by its reference. The text has not been compared with a second, independent edition.
source.licenseNote: The Clementine Vulgate (1592) is in the public domain. The USFX file comes from seven1m/open-bibles (Bible texts that are public domain or openly licensed).
source.modifications: none: each sentence is exactly one verse of the source (surrounding whitespace trimmed).

review.notes: Wording verified by byte-comparison against the Clementine USFX file it was copied from (a copy-integrity check, not a second edition).

verification.against: seven1m/open-bibles Clementine USFX (lat-clementine.usfx.xml, as held by vetus-v0)

english.source: World English Bible (public domain), eBible.org eng-web, copied verbatim from the German/Hindi corpora for the verses they carry

sentences.text: Quod fuit ab initio, quod audivimus, quod vidimus oculis nostris, quod perspeximus, et manus nostræ contrectaverunt de verbo vitæ :
et vita manifestata est, et vidimus, et testamur, et annuntiamus vobis vitam æternam, quæ erat apud Patrem, et apparuit nobis :
quod vidimus et audivimus, annuntiamus vobis, ut et vos societatem habeatis nobiscum, et societas nostra sit cum Patre, et cum Filio ejus Jesu Christo.
Et hæc scribimus vobis ut gaudeatis, et gaudium vestrum sit plenum.
Et hæc est annuntiatio, quam audivimus ab eo, et annuntiamus vobis : quoniam Deus lux est, et tenebræ in eo non sunt ullæ.
Si dixerimus quoniam societatem habemus cum eo, et in tenebris ambulamus, mentimur, et veritatem non facimus.
Si autem in luce ambulamus sicut et ipse est in luce, societatem habemus ad invicem, et sanguis Jesu Christi, Filii ejus, emundat nos ab omni peccato.
Si dixerimus quoniam peccatum non habemus, ipsi nos seducimus, et veritas in nobis non est.
sentences.english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth isn’t in us.

sentences.text: Si confiteamur peccata nostra : fidelis est, et justus, ut remittat nobis peccata nostra, et emundet nos ab omni iniquitate.
sentences.english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

sentences.text: Si dixerimus quoniam non peccavimus, mendacem facimus eum, et verbum ejus non est in nobis.
